outputs.bab-01-moon-star: Night of the 11th, beginning of the night, the waxing moon stood 1 cubit 8 fingers in front of δ Capricorni.
outputs.bab-02-moon-planet: Night of the 2nd, the moon, a waxing crescent, was 1 1/2 cubits behind Jupiter, the moon being 1 cubit high to the north.
outputs.bab-03-planet-planet: Night of the 24th, first part of the night, Venus and Mars were 3 fingers below, with Venus 2 fingers back to the west.
outputs.bab-04-heliacal-rising: The 13th, Venus appeared first in the east, in Scorpius; it was bright, rising to sunrise at 10°; (ideal) first appearance was on the 11th.
outputs.bab-05-lunar-first-visibility: The 1st, the moon first appeared at sunset, 17 degrees before moonset, bright with low earthshine.
